channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rondae Hollis-Jefferson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rondae Hollis-Jefferson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Rondae Hollis-Jefferson
item.description:
Michael Scotto:D'Angelo Russell on Rondae Hollis-Jefferson:

“We tell him every day he's a guy on our team that's the heart and soul. It's simple as that.”

D'Angelo Russell on Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Mar 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Rondae Hollis-Jefferson
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Kenny Atkinson on Rondae Hollis-Jefferson:

“Emotional maturity has been a big growth... just moving on to the next play. We call it 'next play mentality' if you make a mistake or miss a shot, sprint back or whatever that next sequence should look like to help the team.”

Kenny Atkinson on Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Apr 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Rondae Hollis-Jefferson
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Atkinson on if he was afraid Rondae Hollis-Jefferson's injury was long-term:

“No. We’ll evaluate it more... We’ll know more tomorrowbut hopefully nothing serious.”

Kenny Atkinson on Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Jan 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Brett Yormark on Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Bojan Bogdanovic, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson
item.description:
“We’ve got a good story to tell -- with the addition of our $50 million practice facility and the D-League franchise -- and I think we’ll be in a position where we’ll be able to add to Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Bojan Bogdanovic and some of the other younger pieces, and bring in the necessary pieces to turn things around quickly.”

Brett Yormark on Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Bojan Bogdanovic, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Dec 19, 2015. Source: NetsDaily.
